title: How Much Will Be The Height Of Paper Fold If We Fold It 1000 Times

shots.line: What if you folded this piece of paper... a thousand times?
shots.scene: desk top-down: single 80gsm sheet slams into frame on frame 2 with crack-snap; title card 'WHAT IF... 1000 FOLDS?' typewriter-in; small mono tag 'PAPER: 80 GSM · 0.1 mm'; big counter wheel winds 0000 -> 1000 blur then snaps back to 0001 (the question stays open)
shots.notes: hook - sheet = grab beat, 'WHAT IF' card = promise beat, counter spin = open loop; NO claim is given away here; frame-1 replica returns in s009

shots.scene: desk macro breather: the sheet folds ITSELF seven times in fast ticks (counter holds 0001); card strip stamps across: '7 MAX ✗' -> 'OFFICIAL RECORD: 12 ✓' -> '13 unofficial'; NO spoken facts - the cards carry the myth, the voice carries trust
shots.notes: breather - 2.18 s (voice 1.90 + pause), pattern break after the hook; ticks f124/128/133, deny f146, accept f160; ends in dead silence into the skyline reset

shots.line: Keep folding... and it grows taller than the tallest building we've ever built.
shots.scene: void blueprint skyline: FOLDS counter 0023; vertical ruler ladder climbs past a Burj Khalifa silhouette line, receipt stamp 'PAST BURJ KHALIFA ✓ 828 m' pops on 'tallest building' (f273); counter jumps 0027, ruler passes Everest line, stamp 'PAST EVEREST ✓ 8,848 m' lands in the narration gap (f323) as a SILENT receipt; 'FOLDS LEFT: 977' ticker ticks down under the counter
shots.notes: ladder-1 - picture leads, voice never catches up: the Everest stamp lands in the pause after the sentence

shots.line: A few folds later, it climbs into space... and soon passes the Moon.
shots.scene: void orbit band: counter 0030, ruler punches through a horizontal 'SPACE · 100 KM' boundary line, stamp 'PAST SPACE ✓ 100 km' fires on 'climbs into space' (f416); counter 0042 moon stamp 'PAST THE MOON ✓ 384,400 km' with sub-bass landing on 'passes the Moon' (f460)
shots.notes: ladder-2 - white negative space at the boundary crossing = biggest contrast pop so far

shots.line: Then it clears the Sun... and passes Voyager One, the farthest thing humanity ever launched.
shots.scene: void deep space: counter 0051 sun stamp 'PAST THE SUN ✓ 149.6 Mkm' (f539); counter 0058, tiny gray probe glyph tagged 'VOYAGER 1 · 25 BILLION KM · FARTHEST THING HUMANS EVER BUILT' gets passed by the rising ruler (f569) - the human-note beat
shots.notes: ladder-3 - human note on Voyager = mid-ladder emotional spike before the jump

shots.line: Just past one hundred folds, the paper grows bigger than the observable universe.
shots.scene: void cosmos: counter 0103; zoom 0.45s in; the ruler line shoots out of frame on 'bigger' (boom f779); the 'OBSERVABLE UNIVERSE · 93,000,000,000 LY' circle shrinks to a dot under it (arp f803); giant '...AND 897 FOLDS REMAIN' lower card; then the natural paragraph gap (~1 s) acts as the beat drop
shots.notes: universe jump - biggest impact + the hardest pattern break: dead air while the universe is a dot

shots.line: Real paper stopped at twelve. One student needed over a kilometer of tissue.
shots.scene: desk: hard cut back at f839 (debris woosh); crumpled sheet + a tissue roll unrolls across the table with the marker 'GALLIVAN, 2002 · 1,219 M'; card 'PHYSICS LIMIT: 12 FOLDS'; her law plots as a yellow curve eating the frame, marker flags at 12 and 13, 'x4 PAPER EVERY FOLD' tag
shots.notes: reality check - the voice answers the real question (TWELVE folds possible); the trust beat that makes the payoff legal; quiet on purpose, 5.5 s, no lore

shots.line: One thousand folds, and the height is ten to the power of 281 light-years - nothing in the universe comes close.
shots.scene: void black: giant '10^281' types in safety-yellow digit by digit, waterfall of zeros behind, label 'LIGHT-YEARS' (boom lands on 'One thousand folds' f1038); underneath 'UNIVERSE: 93,000,000,000 LY' shrinks to a baseline tick during 'nothing in the universe comes close'; magic shimmer as 281 lands (f1152); comparison bar fills to '10^270x THE UNIVERSE'
shots.notes: payoff - the macro loop closes HERE (the hook's withheld answer lands); loudest audio of the video; digits exact from fold_table.json (display 10^281, never rounded)

shots.line: One sheet of paper, one thousand folds... and the universe comes up short.
shots.scene: desk: exact replica of s001 frame 1 (same sheet position, same 'WHAT IF' card position); counter flashes 'FOLDS 001' once (double-click f1240); at voice end (46.17) the canvas hard-cuts to BLACK inside this shot and holds black to 47.37 (tail ~1.2 s) - brand QC seal prints on the black (brand_pass)
shots.notes: echo ending - replay illusion: last visible frame = first visible frame; the hook question is handed back for the loop; voice ends f1385, black tail f1385-1421
